    Linear structure on an opposite category #

    The opposite of a k-linear category is k-linear, with scalar action transported through morphism reversal.

    source
    @[instance_reducible]

    CategoryTheory.Linear k Cᵒᵖ

    The opposite of a linear category carries the same scalar action on Hom spaces.
